neighbours.label: The complementizer 'whether' (and weaker 'that') opening an embedded claim to be found out; other 'that' and plain clauses stay low
fire: The survey was designed to find out whether the new rules work.

They will decide whether the plan should go ahead.
She wondered whether the letters were genuine.
This trial will show whether the vaccine lasts a year.
